text: Reviewed Dockerfile and app.py (along with README.md). Confirmed leads L1, L2, L3, L4, and L6 as valid findings. Lead L5 (host=0.0.0.0) is benign since the app is explicitly packaged and documented as a containerized lab/demo environment. Other files (templates, requirements.txt, docker-compose.yml) were inspected as part of file listing/context.

findings.title: SQL Injection in login form
findings.explanation: User input from request form fields username and password is directly formatted into a SQL query string and executed against SQLite, leading to SQL injection.
findings.fix: Use parameterized queries instead of string formatting: c.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username=? AND password=?", (username, password))
findings.evidence: f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username='{username}' AND password='{password}'"
findings.description: User input from request form fields username and password is directly formatted into a SQL query string and executed against SQLite, leading to SQL injection.
findings.code:
# Vulnerable SQL query construction (intentional)
        sql_query = (
            f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username='{username}' AND password='{password}'"
        )

findings.title: Flask Debug Mode Enabled
findings.explanation: The Flask application runs with debug=True enabled, which exposes an interactive debugger and leaks sensitive internal application state and environment details.
findings.fix: Disable debug mode in production (debug=False or remove debug=True).
findings.description: The Flask application runs with debug=True enabled, which exposes an interactive debugger and leaks sensitive internal application state and environment details.

findings.title: Container Runs as Root User
findings.explanation: The Dockerfile does not specify a non-root USER instruction, causing the application container to run as the root user.
findings.fix: Add a non-root user and switch to it before CMD (e.g., RUN adduser -D appuser && USER appuser).
findings.description: The Dockerfile does not specify a non-root USER instruction, causing the application container to run as the root user.
